title: On Owing two months of rent
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：owe　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 owe 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the herder ① owed two months of rent in public, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② owes two months of rent in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ owe two months of rent at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ owed two months of rent before — a line in the ledger for December 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Owing two months of rent in public, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ owe everything to one teacher in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Owe everything to one teacher at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ owes everything to one teacher in public every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ owed two months of rent again when nobody else would.

⑩ To owe two months of rent, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody owes two months of rent in silence again and somebody must owe two months of rent in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 欠（一般过去式 owed two months of rent：1963 年牧人头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 欠（一般现在 owes two months of rent：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 欠（不定式 to owe two months of rent：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 欠（过去完成时 had owed two months of rent：1957 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 欠（动名词 owing two months of rent 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 归因于（owe everything to one teacher：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去归因于一切都归功于一位先生）
G. v. 归因于（owe everything to one teacher：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 欠（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 owes everything to one teacher，而母亲又一次 owed two months of rent）

items.q: to owe two months of rent
owed two months of rent before
owe everything to one teacher in silence
owe everything to one teacher at once
owes everything to one teacher in public
owed two months of rent again
to owe two months of rent

answers.why: owe 意为“欠”，1963 年牧人当着众人面欠欠着两个月的房租，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 owed。
owe 意为“欠”，自那以后牧人一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 owes。
owe 意为“欠”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯欠欠着两个月的房租”，此处为不定式 to owe two months of rent。
owe 意为“欠”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1970 年之前就有人欠过，故用过去完成时 had owed。
owe 意为“欠”，牧人说“欠欠着两个月的房租这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 owing two months of rent 作主语。
owe 意为“归因于”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去归因于一切都归功于一位先生”，should ever 之后用原形 owe everything to one teacher。
owe 意为“归因于”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻归因于一切都归功于一位先生（owe everything to one teacher at once），以后再也不要提起。
owe 意为“欠”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例归因于一切都归功于一位先生，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 owes。
owe 意为“欠”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面欠欠着两个月的房租，用一般过去式 owed 叙述。
owe 意为“欠”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要欠欠着两个月的房租，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，牧人当着众人面欠欠着两个月的房租；牧场里每一个邻人都说这是头一回。（owed two months of rent）
多年以后，牧人仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（owes two months of rent）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯欠欠着两个月的房租这件事本身。（to owe two months of rent）
早在 1957 年就有人欠欠着两个月的房租，十二月那天牧群台账上的一行字就是证据。（had owed two months of rent）
牧人说过，当着众人面欠欠着两个月的房租这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（owing two months of rent 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻归因于一切都归功于一位先生，以后再也不要提起。（owe everything to one teacher，祈使句）
answers: In 1963 the herder owed two months of rent in public, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three winters on, the herder still owes two months of rent in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to owe two months of rent at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had owed two months of rent long before 1970, and the line in the ledger for December proves it.
Owing two months of rent in public, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Owe everything to one teacher at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 owe 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the herder owed two months of rent in public, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder owes two months of rent in silence whenever the pasture asks.
Owing two months of rent in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever owe everything to one teacher in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture owes everything to one teacher in public every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother owed two months of rent again, and the pasture remembered that half.
